wordings.a: Epistemic rigor: how carefully the post handles evidence and inference — claims proportioned to support, alternatives considered, uncertainty stated where it exists.
wordings.b: Quality of reasoning discipline: does the argument survive hostile reading — each step valid, evidence real and weighed, confounds and counter-explanations addressed rather than ignored?
wordings.c: If a domain expert audited this post line by line, how few unsupported leaps, motivated readings of evidence, or quietly-dropped caveats would they find?

wordings.a: Novelty of insight: how much genuinely new understanding the post contributes — an idea, distinction, or synthesis a well-read rationalist would not already possess.
wordings.b: Originality: is the core move of this post something you had not seen before reading it — a fresh frame, mechanism, or connection — rather than a restatement of community common knowledge?
wordings.c: How large is the delta between what a five-year LessWrong veteran believed before reading this post and after — counting only understanding that is new, not rehearsed?

wordings.a: Technical alpha: how much genuine, exciting technical signal the text delivers to a top-percentile practitioner already fluent in its area — mechanisms, measurements, techniques, or design-space dimensions they did not already hold and could not cheaply regenerate from standard documentation — as opposed to noise: competent restatement of known material, topic heat, jargon, or performed novelty.
wordings.b: Instantiate the prior of a strong practitioner in this text's field — everything already priced into their model — and score only the residual: the concrete technical update they finish with. Polished explainers of documented material score near zero; text with no technical payload has nothing to give.
wordings.c: If a working expert in this area read this and then had it erased from memory, how much of their actual understanding or practice would be lost — a real technique, number, or mechanism they cannot get elsewhere — versus nothing, because it was hot-topic vocabulary and confident register?

wordings.a: Epistemic-pollution restraint: the project adds signal, not noise, to its information commons — no inflated claims seeding hype cycles, no low-quality content flooding channels others depend on.
wordings.b: Inventory the public claims and content this project will emit; rate the fraction that will still look true and useful in three years.
wordings.c: After this project's communications run their course, is the public conversation about its topic better calibrated or worse?

wordings.a: Novel world-expanding hit: the proposal aims at something genuinely new — if it succeeds, the world contains a capability, institution, or piece of knowledge it simply did not have before, rather than more of an existing kind.
wordings.b: Estimate the expansion this proposal buys if funded and successful: how much does it enlarge what humanity can do, know, or coordinate on, beyond scaling an approach that already exists elsewhere?
wordings.c: If this proposal were never funded, would the thing it builds plausibly not exist for years — or would a near-substitute arrive anyway from adjacent teams and ordinary momentum? Score high only where the counterfactual gap is real.

wordings.a: Theory of change clarity: the proposal articulates precisely how its activities produce its intended outcome — who changes what behavior, through what mechanism, observable how.
wordings.b: Could a skeptical reader draw this project's causal diagram from the proposal alone — inputs, activities, intermediate outcomes, endpoint — with no hand-waving arrows?
wordings.c: Rate the explicitness of the path to impact: is the mechanism named and examinable, or does the proposal jump from 'we will do X' to 'the world improves'?
